scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB "npm run start:dev --workspace=@taskflow/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@taskflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@taskflow/api && npm run build --workspace=@taskflow/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@taskflow/api && npm run lint --workspace=@taskflow/web
scripts.e2e:db:reset: docker exec taskflow-postgres dropdb --if-exists --force -U taskflow taskflow_e2e && docker exec taskflow-postgres createdb -U taskflow taskflow_e2e
scripts.e2e:api: cross-env NODE_ENV=development DATABASE_URL=postgresql://taskflow:taskflow@127.0.0.1:5432/taskflow_e2e FRONTEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 npm run start:dev --workspace=@taskflow/api
scripts.test:e2e: npm run e2e:db:reset && npm run e2e:db:migrate && start-server-and-test "npm run e2e:api" http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/health "npm run e2e:web" http://127.0.0.1:5173 "npm run e2e:cypress"
